text_block_list.text:
One day,
while walking through the Tracen Academy building—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry!
I was daydreaming...
choice_data_list: You look down. What's the matter?
You look down. What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Eh?
W-Was it that obvious on my face...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, folks from my hometown
are coming over here to visit soon.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There happens to be a mock race scheduled,
so they said they'd come cheer for me...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I'm super happy about that on its own, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san and other strong girls will be in the race,
so I'm worried whether I can get good results.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When I think about disappointing everyone
who came all the way from far away to support me...

Yukino Bijin's worries were understandable, but being too
anxious to perform at her best would defeat the purpose.
Just as I was about to tell her that—

Mumu?! 
My Class Rep Sensor has detected a student's distress!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-san!
The source of the signal is none other than you, correct?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nothing escapes the eyes of the Class President!
If you have troubles, speak them to me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Eh... Eeeeeh?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I completely understand your dilemma!
...Very well!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As everyone's Class President,
I shall personally give you special training!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To win a race, special training is the only answer!
Trainer over there, you agree as well, don't you?!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's learn from the Class President's sheer nerve!
Yeah! Let's learn from the Class President's sheer nerve!
Yeah! Let's learn from the Class President's way of running!
Yeah! Let's learn from the Class President's way of running!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To win a race, special training is the only answer!
Trainer over there, you agree as well, don't you?!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's learn from the Class President's sheer nerve!
Yeah! Let's learn from the Class President's sheer nerve!
Yeah! Let's learn from the Class President's way of running!
Yeah! Let's learn from the Class President's way of running!

text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O's ever-confident composure
would certainly be an asset in any race.

I told her that if she could run at her own pace
without being rattled by those around her,
she could unleash 100% of her true ability—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's true that I've let nerves get the better of my running
more than a few times before...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! In other words, your objective now
is to become Class President material!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now that it is decided,
let us proceed to a venue fit for special training!

Though Sakura Bakushin O was full of confidence,
I felt a slight sense of unease and decided to accompany them.

The place Sakura Bakushin O led us to
was right in front of the central plaza.

There, magazine reporters were conducting
interviews with students passing by.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Feature: Real Voices of Tracen Academy!"—
Yukino-san and I shall be interviewed as well!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Special training begins now, Yukino-san!
If you can answer their questions with composure,
your nerve will truly be on par with a Class President!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My running philosophy? Why, to be an exemplary model for everyone...
To run just like a Class President, of course!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, as for me, well... I was just hopin'
I could run real cool-like, like the other girls...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mumu! You lack confidence and momentum,
Yukino-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Lay bare your inner feelings even more!
You want to return home covered in glory, do you not?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...To my hometown—

text_block_list.name: Older Woman
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chan,
don't you go losing to those city folk, give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so much for seein' me off!
You even made such a grand banner for me... *sniffle*.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I swear I'm gonna get super strong
and become an umamusume y'all can be proud of...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(That's right... I gotta let everyone back home
see me when I've become a real 'city girl'...!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I want to... run a race that won't bring shame
to everyone back home rootin' for me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I want to sparkle and look so cool in races
that I won't lose to any city girl...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that interview truly conveyed your feelings
for your hometown and your passion for racing!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's 'cause I remembered what's most important...
Thanks to you, looks like I've found my courage!

Sakura Bakushin O's spirited running
and powerful burst of speed when it counts
are truly remarkable.

When I told them that learning from her running would
broaden her tactical options and raise her chances of winning—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Quite so, quite so!
You have a remarkably sharp discerning eye!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Leave everything to me! Starting today,
Yukino-san's running will be Class President level!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
T-That sounds pretty amazin', I reckon...
...Wait, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, this is merely my natural duty as Class President!
Now then, go get changed and assemble at the grounds!

Sakura Bakushin O was brimming with confidence,
but feeling a slight sense of unease,
I decided to head over to the meeting spot.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
First up, we shall conduct
a Class President-Style Shuttle Run!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Each runner must sprint while shouting whatever words they like!
It will well up far more vitality than usual, making you run faster!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so?
Well then, um—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do thiiiis!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Splendid form!
I cannot afford to fall behind either!

And so, Yukino Bijin and the others proceeded to power through
one Class President-style training drill after another.

Though many of the exercises were rather eccentric,
they all directly connected to the core essence
of Sakura Bakushin O's running.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*...
All that remains now is the final finishing drill.
choice_data_list: You should take a break first.
You should take a break first.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
*whew*, *phew*... I-Indeed.
Shall we take a brief intermission?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Even so, to keep up properly with this training regiment
is quite an impressive feat on your part.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Thanks to you,
I feel like I've gotten the hang of how to run!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, on to our final drill!
Let us sprint straight toward the setting sun with all our heart!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Sweating profusely, gritting your teeth, showing pure grit—
Living an exemplary youth is what makes a true Class President!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If you harbor that blazing fighting spirit forged right here in your heart,
you shall surely triumph in any race!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I see~! I've seen that kind of scene
on TV drama reruns before!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be just like those drama kids...
Alright, let's do thiiis!
